_comment: LiSenNet NPU-HARDENED conv variant. Same sub-band U-Net + dual-path CONV bottleneck as configs/lisennet_conv_wide.json, but with deploy-friendly primitives so the exported int8 graph compiles to the STM32N6 Neural-ART NPU (the conv_wide variant maps its operators but crashes atonn at codegen on the 2-axis CustomLayerNorm / PReLU). norm='batchnorm' replaces the per-frame 2-axis CustomLayerNorm with a per-channel nn.BatchNorm2d (fixed stats, folds into the adjacent conv, NPU-native); act='relu' replaces PReLU/Mish/LearnableSigmoid with parameter-free ReLU/Sigmoid (removes the per-channel float slopes that block full int8). Mirrors ConvFSENet's quant-friendly recipe (conv->bn->relu). Requires retraining (the norm/activation swap changes behaviour); the input is already power-compressed (compress_factor 0.3) which tames dynamic range and reduces the need for the per-frame norm. Retrain from scratch into cp_lisennet_conv_hardened; A/B FP32 PESQ against cp_lisennet_conv_wide (2.970).
